What should I do first if I am hospitalized during my trip?

You, or someone on your behalf, must contact the Company's hotline immediately if you are admitted as an in-patient or have any medical emergency. The Company's medical team will keep in touch with the hospital and your doctors (Section 1, p. 12; Notice of Claim, p. 42).

Ano ang dapat kong unang gawin kung ma-ospital ako habang nasa biyahe?

Ikaw o ang sinumang kumakatawan sa iyo ay dapat tumawag agad sa hotline ng Kompanya kapag na-admit ka sa ospital o may medical emergency. Ang medical team ng Kompanya ang makikipag-ugnayan sa ospital at sa iyong mga doktor (Section 1, p. 12; Notice of Claim, p. 42).

Ano unang gagawin ko pag na-hospital ako habang nasa trip?

Tawagan agad ang hotline ng Company, ikaw man o kasama mo, once na-admit ka or may medical emergency. Yung medical team nila ang mag-co-coordinate sa hospital at sa doctors mo (Section 1, p. 12; Notice of Claim, p. 42).

Does the COVID rider cover other pandemics or epidemics?

No. The rider is for COVID-19 only. Other epidemics, pandemics and communicable diseases declared by a government agency that require quarantine measures are not covered under the rider or the main travel policy (COVID-19 Endorsement, Terms 11-12, p. 3).

Sagot ba ng COVID rider ang ibang pandemya o epidemya?

Hindi. Para sa COVID-19 lamang ang rider. Ang ibang epidemya, pandemya at nakahahawang sakit na idineklara ng gobyerno at nangangailangan ng quarantine ay hindi sagot ng rider o ng pangunahing travel policy (COVID-19 Endorsement, Terms 11-12, p. 3).

Kasama ba sa COVID rider yung ibang pandemic o epidemic?

Hindi. COVID-19 lang ang sakop ng rider. Yung ibang epidemic, pandemic at communicable disease na dineclare ng government at may quarantine ay hindi covered, pati sa main travel policy (COVID-19 Endorsement, Terms 11-12, p. 3).

Who decides if I need to be evacuated or sent home for treatment?

The Company's medical team decides, based on contact with your doctors, which properly equipped health center you go to, whether repatriation is needed and the most suitable transport. Minor cases are moved by ambulance or other transport to where adequate care is available (Section 3, pp. 13-14).

Sino ang magpapasya kung kailangan akong ilipat o pauwiin para magpagamot?

Ang medical team ng Kompanya ang magpapasya, batay sa pakikipag-usap sa iyong mga doktor, kung saang maayos na health center ka dadalhin, kung kailangan kang pauwiin, at kung anong sasakyan ang pinakaangkop. Sa hindi malalang kaso, ililipat ka sa pamamagitan ng ambulansya o ibang sasakyan sa lugar na may sapat na gamutan (Section 3, pp. 13-14).

Sino magdedecide kung kailangan ako i-evacuate or pauwiin?

Ang medical team ng Company ang magdedecide, after makausap ang doctors mo, kung saang health center ka dadalhin, kung kailangan ng repatriation, at anong transport ang best. Pag minor lang, by ambulance or ibang transport lang papunta sa may tamang care (Section 3, pp. 13-14).

What if I have to stay longer abroad because I am sick and my policy is about to expire?

If a covered accident or illness forces you to extend your stay, the period of insurance is automatically extended once only, for up to 10 days. The benefit limits for that claim are not increased (Section 19, p. 33).

Paano kung kailangan kong manatili nang mas matagal sa ibang bansa dahil may sakit ako at mag-e-expire na ang policy ko?

Kung dahil sa covered na aksidente o sakit ay kailangan mong pahabain ang pananatili, awtomatikong mapapalawig ang period of insurance nang isang beses lamang, hanggang 10 araw. Hindi madaragdagan ang limits para sa claim na iyon (Section 19, p. 33).

Paano kung ma-extend stay ko abroad dahil nagkasakit ako at mag-e-expire na policy ko?

Kung dahil sa covered accident o illness ay ma-extend ang stay mo, automatic na ma-e-extend ang coverage once lang, up to 10 days. Pero hindi tataas ang benefit limits ng claim na yun (Section 19, p. 33).

Am I covered if I have an accident while drunk?

No. Accidents suffered while inebriated (blood alcohol above 0.50 g per 1,000 cc, or if fined or convicted for it) or under the influence of drugs are excluded from Personal Accident and Burial benefits, and claims arising from alcohol or non-prescribed drugs are excluded under the general exclusions (p. 20; General Exclusion 21, p. 35).

Sagot ba ako kung maaksidente ako habang lasing?

Hindi. Hindi sagot ang aksidente habang lasing (blood alcohol na higit 0.50 g bawat 1,000 cc, o kung namultahan o nahatulan dahil dito) o nasa impluwensya ng droga sa Personal Accident at Burial benefits, at hindi rin sagot ang claim dahil sa alak o drogang hindi nireseta ayon sa general exclusions (p. 20; General Exclusion 21, p. 35).

Covered ba kung naaksidente ako habang lasing?

Hindi. Excluded ang accident habang lasing (blood alcohol above 0.50 g per 1,000 cc, o kung na-fine o na-convict dahil dito) o naka-drugs sa Personal Accident at Burial, at excluded din sa general exclusions ang claims dahil sa alcohol o non-prescribed drugs (p. 20; General Exclusion 21, p. 35).

I booked my flight with airline miles. What do I get if I cancel for a covered reason?

If the airline won't refund your points, the Company refunds the cost of an equivalent class ticket at the retail price when the ticket was issued. If only some points are refunded, you get that ticket cost less the value of the points refunded (Section 9, p. 23).

Ginamit ko ang airline miles sa pag-book. Ano ang makukuha ko kung magkansela ako dahil sa covered na dahilan?

Kung hindi ibabalik ng airline ang iyong points, ibabalik ng Kompanya ang halaga ng tiket na kaparehong klase batay sa retail price noong inisyu ang tiket. Kung bahagi lamang ng points ang naibalik, makukuha mo ang halagang iyon bawas ang halaga ng naibalik na points (Section 9, p. 23).

Naka-miles yung booking ko. Ano makukuha ko kung nag-cancel ako for a covered reason?

Kung hindi ire-refund ng airline ang points mo, ire-refund ng Company ang cost ng equivalent class ticket base sa retail price nung na-issue ang ticket. Kung partial lang ang na-refund na points, yung ticket cost minus value ng na-refund na points ang makukuha mo (Section 9, p. 23).

What documents do I need for a trip curtailment claim?

The vouchers or certificate of the event that made you cut the trip short, written confirmation from the appropriate authority with full details, and all receipts for extra expenses (Section 10, pp. 23-24). The claim form checklist also asks for the airline itinerary or booking, certification of cancellation, copy of ticket and an incident report.

Anong mga dokumento ang kailangan ko para sa trip curtailment claim?

Ang voucher o sertipiko ng pangyayaring nagpaikli sa biyahe, nakasulat na kumpirmasyon mula sa tamang awtoridad na may buong detalye, at lahat ng resibo ng dagdag na gastos (Section 10, pp. 23-24). Hinihingi rin ng checklist sa claim form ang airline itinerary o booking, certification ng cancellation, kopya ng tiket at incident report.

Anong documents ang need ko for trip curtailment claim?

Yung vouchers o certificate ng event na dahilan ng pag-cut short, written confirmation mula sa appropriate authority na may full details, at lahat ng receipts ng extra expenses (Section 10, pp. 23-24). Sa claim form checklist, kailangan din ang airline itinerary o booking, certification ng cancellation, copy ng ticket at incident report.

Is there a benefit if my plane is hijacked?

Yes. The Aircraft Skyjacking benefit pays the scheduled amount for each 6-hour period (domestic trips) or 12-hour period (international trips) that the hijacking prevents you from reaching the destination, up to the limit and hours in the Policy Schedule (Section 12, p. 26).

May benepisyo ba kung ma-hijack ang eroplano ko?

Oo. Ang Aircraft Skyjacking benefit ay nagbabayad ng nakatakdang halaga sa bawat 6 na oras (domestic) o 12 oras (international) na pinipigilan ka ng hijacking na makarating sa destinasyon, hanggang sa limitang nasa Policy Schedule (Section 12, p. 26).

May benefit ba kung na-hijack yung eroplano?

Yes. Ang Aircraft Skyjacking benefit ay nagbabayad per 6-hour period (domestic) o 12-hour period (international) na hindi ka makarating sa destination dahil sa hijacking, up to the Policy Schedule limit (Section 12, p. 26).

My bag was stolen at the hotel. Is it covered?

Burglary from a hotel room is covered only if the room was locked and there are visible signs of forced entry; robbery means taking by force or threat. You must file a police report within 24 hours listing the items and their value, and send a copy to the Company (Section 14, p. 27). Items left unattended in public places are excluded (p. 30).

Ninakaw ang bag ko sa hotel. Sagot ba ito?

Sagot ang pagnanakaw sa kuwarto ng hotel kung nakakandado ito at may nakikitang palatandaan ng sapilitang pagpasok; ang robbery ay pagkuha gamit ang dahas o pananakot. Kailangang mag-report sa pulis sa loob ng 24 oras, ilista ang mga gamit at halaga, at ipadala ang kopya sa Kompanya (Section 14, p. 27). Hindi sagot ang gamit na iniwang walang bantay sa pampublikong lugar (p. 30).

Kailangan mag-file ng police report within 24 hours na may list ng items at value, tapos ipadala ang copy sa Company (Section 14, p. 27). Is stolen cash covered?

Yes, under Loss of Personal Money, if your cash, traveller's cheques, banknotes or credit card are lost or stolen through robbery, burglary or natural disaster while in your care. You must take reasonable care, report to the local police within 24 hours, submit the police documentation and prove ownership (Section 15, p. 28).

Sagot ba ang ninakaw na pera?

Oo, sa Loss of Personal Money, kung ang iyong cash, traveller's cheque, perang papel o credit card ay nawala o ninakaw dahil sa robbery, burglary o kalamidad habang hawak mo. Dapat ay nag-ingat ka, nag-report sa lokal na pulis sa loob ng 24 oras, nagsumite ng dokumento ng pulis at may patunay ng pagmamay-ari (Section 15, p. 28).

Covered ba kung nanakaw yung cash ko?

Yes, under Loss of Personal Money, kung nawala o nanakaw ang cash, traveller's cheques o credit card mo dahil sa robbery, burglary o natural disaster habang hawak mo. Kailangan nag-ingat ka, nag-report sa police within 24 hours, may police documentation at proof of ownership (Section 15, p. 28).

Does the policy cover my rental car excess?

Yes. Car Rental Protection reimburses the excess or deductible you become legally liable for when the rented vehicle is damaged in an accident, up to PHP 10,000. The car must be from a licensed rental agency, the rental agreement must include comprehensive motor insurance, and you must follow the rental terms (Section 20, p. 33).

Oo. Ire-reimburse ng Car Rental Protection ang excess o deductible na legal mong babayaran kapag nasira sa aksidente ang inarkilang sasakyan, hanggang PHP 10,000. Dapat galing ito sa lisensyadong rental agency, may comprehensive motor insurance ang kasunduan, at sinunod mo ang mga tuntunin ng rental (Section 20, p. 33).

Covered ba yung excess o deductible ng rental car ko?

Yes. Ire-reimburse ng Car Rental Protection ang excess o deductible na babayaran mo pag nasira sa accident ang rented car, up to PHP 10,000. Dapat licensed rental agency, may comprehensive motor insurance ang rental agreement, at sinunod mo ang rental terms (Section 20, p. 33).

Are pregnancy and childbirth covered?

No. Claims arising from pregnancy or childbirth are excluded from the medical sections, from trip cancellation and curtailment, and under the general exclusions (Exclusion 9, p. 15; Exclusion 18, p. 25; General Exclusion 20, p. 35).

Hindi. Hindi sagot ang claim na dulot ng pagbubuntis o panganganak sa medical sections, trip cancellation at curtailment, at sa general exclusions (Exclusion 9, p. 15; Exclusion 18, p. 25; General Exclusion 20, p. 35).

Is treatment for anxiety, depression or stress covered?

No. Claims related to psychological or psychiatric disorders, anxiety, depression, or nervous or stress-related disorders are excluded (Exclusion 11, p. 15). Mental or nervous illness is also excluded for trip cancellation and curtailment (Exclusion 14, p. 25).

Is a domestic trip within the Philippines covered?

Yes, if the destination is at least 100 km from your residence or place of business when travelling by land or sea, or the trip requires at least one round-trip flight. For non-air travel, cover starts when you actually leave your usual residence (Definition 17, p. 5).

Sagot ba ang biyahe sa loob ng Pilipinas?

Oo, kung ang destinasyon ay hindi bababa sa 100 km mula sa iyong tirahan o negosyo kapag bumibiyahe sa lupa o dagat, o kung nangangailangan ng kahit isang round-trip na flight. Para sa biyaheng hindi eroplano, nagsisimula ang coverage pag-alis mo sa iyong tirahan (Definition 17, p. 5).

Yes, kung at least 100 km ang layo ng destination mula sa bahay o business mo pag by land o sea, o kung may at least one round-trip flight. Sa non-air travel, nag-start ang cover pag-alis mo ng bahay (Definition 17, p. 5).

Can I get a refund if I cancel my trip and policy?

If you cancel a trip before the policy's effective date or within 30 days after it and notify the Company, the premium paid for that trip is refunded less documentary stamp and premium taxes. For other cancellations by the policyholder, the Company keeps a share of the annual premium: 40% at 2 months, 50% at 3, 60% at 4, 70% at 5, 75% at 6, and 100% after 6 months (Cancellation, p. 44).

Makakakuha ba ako ng refund kung kanselahin ko ang biyahe at policy?

Kung kanselahin mo ang biyahe bago ang effective date o sa loob ng 30 araw matapos ito at ipinaalam sa Kompanya, ibabalik ang premium para sa biyaheng iyon bawas ang documentary stamp at premium taxes. Sa ibang pagkansela ng policyholder, kukunin ng Kompanya ang bahagi ng annual premium: 40% sa 2 buwan, 50% sa 3, 60% sa 4, 70% sa 5, 75% sa 6, at 100% lampas 6 na buwan (Cancellation, p. 44).

May refund ba kung i-cancel ko ang trip at policy ko?

Kung i-cancel mo ang trip bago ang effective date o within 30 days after at in-inform mo ang Company, ire-refund ang premium ng trip na yun minus documentary stamp at premium taxes. Sa ibang cancellation ng policyholder, may retained na percentage ng annual premium: 40% sa 2 months, 50% sa 3, 60% sa 4, 70% sa 5, 75% sa 6, at 100% after 6 months (Cancellation, p. 44).
